indicators.label: Census population
indicators.description: Published census population for the county and wave.
indicators.method: Use the Croatian Bureau of Statistics published county total.
indicators.temporal_coverage: Croatian Bureau of Statistics population censuses 2001, 2011, and 2021.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty counties and the City of Zagreb as published by the Croatian Bureau of Statistics, joined by source order and official county code to the current State Geodetic Administration layer.
indicators.quality_notes: The statistical definition of total population changed between the 2001 and 2011 censuses.

indicators.label: Census religious affiliation (%)
indicators.description: Share of the whole census population in a published religious-affiliation category.
indicators.method: 100 times the sum of mutually exclusive published religious-affiliation categories divided by population_total.
indicators.temporal_coverage: Croatian Bureau of Statistics population censuses 2001, 2011, and 2021.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty counties and the City of Zagreb as published by the Croatian Bureau of Statistics, joined by source order and official county code to the current State Geodetic Administration layer.
indicators.quality_notes: The 2001 category Agnostici i neizjašnjeni (Agnostic and uncommitted) combines an agnostic response with non-declaration. It remains outside both headline numerators. The 2021 category Ostali kršćani (Other Christians) also changed composition because 96.47% of the category answered Christian without naming a denomination.

indicators.method: 100 times the explicit source no-religion category divided by population_total; agnostic categories remain separate.

The 2021 category Ostali kršćani (Other Christians) also changed composition because 96.47% of the category answered Christian without naming a denomination.

visual_layers.label: Census religious affiliation (%)
visual_layers.description: Religious-affiliation share of the whole census population by county for 2001, 2011, and 2021.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: sum mutually exclusive source religious-affiliation categories and divide by population_total
visual_layers.notes: The 2001 source combines Agnostici i neizjašnjeni (Agnostic and uncommitted), which mixes an agnostic response with non-declaration. The 2011 and 2021 sources instead publish Agnostici i skeptici (Agnostics and sceptics), Ne izjašnjavaju se (Not declared), and Nepoznato (Unknown) separately. All remain distinct source categories. Headline shares use the whole population denominator. The 2021 workbook notes that Ostali kršćani (Other Christians) includes people who answered Christian without a denomination; 96.47% of that category did so, and 87.26% of those respondents named the Catholic Church when asked about religious community. The build retains the published category and does not reassign those people. This classification break limits cross-wave interpretation. Geometric stability of Croatian county boundaries across 2001, 2011, and 2021 was not verified. The common current boundary join uses the 21 county positions and official codes shared by the published DZS county rows and the current DGU layer. Code identity does not prove polygon stability, and the product reports no county-level change statistic as a same-polygon comparison.

visual_layers.label: No religion (%)
visual_layers.description: Share of the whole census population in the explicit source no-religion category.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: Nisu vjernici or Nisu vjernici i ateisti divided by population_total; agnostic categories remain separate
